summary: For our project, we chose to build a website using NASA's enormous database as our guide. We want a website that could be informative, interesting and of course, easy enough to understand as the first introduction for the younger generation to the topic of space exploration. We have built a website with the help of AI in coding while our illustration remain 100% human – made. The website include small interactive activities after each introduction to help keep the attention and make it more memorable by using imagines and actions for active learning. The reason why we think this is important is that, these days, technologies are advancing rapidly and so are social media and the gaming industry. Kids are getting hooked to these online realities that some already forgot about the outside world. Ask a kid what they want to be when they grow up and the answers are much different than what we got years ago as now most of them either want to become an influencer, Youtuber or a gamer. It saddens us to see how much the kids have forgotten about the wonder that is the universe. We want to show these next generations the inspiration we felt when we were at their age and by doing so, hopefully, we can help lead them into the amazing world of science.
